input:
If ā, b̄, c̄ are three vectors such that ā · (b̄ + c̄) + b̄ · (c̄ + ā) + c̄ · (ā + b̄) = 0 and |ā| = 1, |b̄| = 8 and |c̄| = 4, then |ā + b̄ + c̄| has the value ________.

Options:
A. 81
B. 9
C. 5
D. 4

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Given ā·(b̄+c̄) + b̄·(c̄+ā) + c̄·(ā+b̄) = 0 and vector magnitudes |ā|=1, |b̄|=8, |c̄|=4, compute |ā + b̄ + c̄|.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Expanding the dot product relation gives 2(ā·b̄ + b̄·c̄ + c̄·ā) = 0. Use the expansion formula |ā + b̄ + c̄|² = |ā|² + |b̄|² + |c̄|² + 2(ā·b̄ + b̄·c̄ + c̄·ā).

key_concepts: Vector dot product distributivity: ā·(b̄+c̄) = ā·b̄ + ā·c̄
Symmetry of dot product: ā·b̄ = b̄·ā
Magnitude of sum formula: |ā + b̄ + c̄|² = |ā|² + |b̄|² + |c̄|² + 2(ā·b̄ + b̄·c̄ + c̄·ā)

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Expand the given relation to conclude 2(ā·b̄ + b̄·c̄ + c̄·ā) = 0, then compute |ā + b̄ + c̄|² by substituting given magnitudes, and take the square root.
logical_steps: Step 3: Write |ā + b̄ + c̄|² = |ā|² + |b̄|² + |c̄|² + 2(ā·b̄ + b̄·c̄ + c̄·ā)
